children.name: eyebrow
children.label: Eyebrow
children.help_text: Optional short label above the section heading.

children.name: heading
children.label: Heading
children.help_text: Section heading above the cards. Leave blank to hide it.

children.name: intro
children.label: Intro text
children.help_text: Optional. One or two sentences under the section heading.

children.name: card_heading_level
children.label: Card heading level
children.help_text: Semantic level for every card heading. Choose the level below the section heading.

children.name: image
children.label: Card image
children.help_text: Optional. Shown at the top of the card, cropped to 16:9.

children.name: body_text
children.label: Body
children.default: Describe the item, feature or service in a sentence or two.

default.heading: Strategy that fits

default.heading: Built to last
default.body_text: Reusable building blocks keep every page consistent and quick to change as you grow.

default.heading: Measured results
default.body_text: Clear reporting shows what is working, so you can invest where it counts.

$append.name: columns

$append.help_text: Desktop. Tablets show 2 per row and phones show 1.

$append.name: card_style
